title: Policy question, then asks for a person

turns.customer: Quick question before I use Paylane for something big: how do refunds work? Is there a limit?
turns.reply: Each card purchase is looked at on its own, and there's no cap on the total. I can refund a settled card purchase myself if it's $75.00 or less and less than 30 days old, and it's always refunded in full, once. Purchases over $75, ones 30 days old or more, and money sent to another person go to a person on our team for review, and a pending charge has to settle before it can be refunded.
